note: Declared dispositions for Horca-owned tracked files that contain a public product-identity literal. scripts/verify-product-identity.mjs fails on any matching file absent from this registry.

overlay/manifest.json.reason: The upstream literals appear only as declared overlay find-sentinels that Gate C replaces; they are not emitted identity.

docs/horca/distribution.md.reason: Fork-era distribution documentation; describes the superseded dual-distribution model.

src/shared/distribution-identity.json.reason: Describes upstream Orca's own identity alongside Horca's so the dormant fork machinery can keep them separate. Horca builds select the horca profile; the official profile is never selected. Not reachable from the pinned-input production build.

src/shared/distribution-identity.ts.reason: Same dual-distribution identity contract as the JSON; Horca builds resolve the horca profile via distribution-build-profile.

src/shared/distribution-identity.test.ts.reason: Test asserting the dual-distribution identity contract stays in sync.

src/shared/distribution-product-copy.ts.reason: Per-distribution product copy; Horca selects the horca profile.

src/shared/horca/distribution-translatio.reason: Per-distribution i18n catalog plugin; not part of the pinned-input production build.

config/electron-builder-downstream.cjs.reason: Superseded fork-era downstream builder post-processor. Gate C replaces it with the product.json packaging seam; removal is tracked as identity/dead-code cleanup.

src/main/horca/configure-horca-user-data.reason: Test of the Horca user-data configuration against the dual-distribution contract.

src/shared/horca-pairing.test.ts.reason: Asserts that the `orca:` deep-link wire format stays accepted for cross-client compatibility; OS-level registration is horca only.
